description: Property names encoding/json accepts in a struct tag. They still need escaping on the way into generated Go: a percent sign is read by fmt as a verb unless doubled, and the name is emitted into both map keys and error messages.

arrPct%s.description: An array whose name carries a percent. The length check keeps the name as an argument rather than splicing it into the format string, so the percent is never read as a verb.
